answer: Sybil wall: require TEE hardware attestation per identity — a sealed quorum mints a karst-key inside the enclave, layered like rock strata so forging one identity means redoing every layer above it. Each attested key posts a bond of 300% of its first 30 days' expected fees, locked 90 days and non-transferable across keys; a gale of fresh identities pays that bond per head, while honest agents pay once. Each epoch 5% of keys are re-probed by a reef-indexed random sampler: one forged quote slashes the bond, forfeits the key, and invalidates every attestation it countersigned.
